title: Academic Ally Agent Architecture
subtitle: One parent orchestrator coordinates five specialist agents.

orchestrator.name: Academic Ally Parent Orchestrator
orchestrator.summary: Manages the conversation, chooses the correct specialist agent, summarizes outputs, and asks for confirmation before important data is saved.

agents.name: Student Profile & Onboarding Agent
agents.exampleInput: College student, 15 study hours per week, evenings preferred.
agents.exampleOutput: Profile saved with realistic planning limits.

agents.name: Syllabus & Course Intelligence Agent
agents.exampleOutput: Courses, deadlines, weights, and uncertain items are extracted for review.

agents.name: Learner Diagnostic Agent
agents.exampleInput: Matrices: somewhat familiar. Cell structure: familiar.
agents.exampleOutput: Familiarity scores inform the workload plan.

agents.name: Workload Planning Agent
agents.exampleInput: Three graded requirements due within three days.
agents.exampleOutput: High-risk workload is ranked by urgency, weight, difficulty, and progress.

agents.name: Execution & Accountability Agent
agents.exampleInput: Student asks to skip a focus block because they barely slept.
agents.exampleOutput: Break request is weighed against deadlines and progress before rescheduling.

guardrails: Route each request to the correct specialist agent.
Flag uncertain syllabus information instead of inventing missing details.
Ask for confirmation before saving tasks, schedules, reminders, or focus sessions.
Explain why a task is prioritized so the student can trust the plan.
